notes:
Summary: Enterprise RAG/search vendor evaluating Redwood for embeddings + reranking path. Heavy emphasis on vector DB connector capabilities and predictable cost per query. Primary request: demo of Dedicated with VPC peering and an Elastic/pgvector connector for legacy indices.

Key requirements (customer language / paraphrase):
- "We need sub-100ms tail latency for 2k-doc context at 200 QPS for front-line QA and support flows."
- Elastic legacy store for 60M docs (already sharded), want to run hybrid queries (keyword + embedding) and then server-side reranking with a light MLP reranker to reduce token generation.
- Real-time ingestion: streaming upserts (low-latency), bulk backfill (60M docs), per-namespace TTLs.
- Connector must support: bulk-upsert API, incremental sync (CDC-friendly), metadata filters, custom namespace->collection mapping, field-level encryption compatibility, and backpressure signals for batching.
- Embedding/versioning control: keep v1/v2 vectors side-by-side, ability to reindex a subset and roll forward without downtime.
- Reranking flow: retrieval (ANN) -> lightweight reranker (on CPU or small GPU) -> generation fallback. Need policies to offload reranker if latency budget exceeded.

Indexing/scale constraints:
- Current corpus: 60M docs -> ~350M chunks (avg 6 chunks/doc). Expect 3x growth over 12 months.
- Target shard sizing: want connector that can map to their existing Elastic sharding model OR allow incremental migration to Pinecone/Weaviate/pgvector.
- Desired cold-storage policy for older docs (cost control) with rehydration within minutes.

Latency / throughput / cost targets:
- 95th pct latency target for end-to-end retrieval+rerank: <= 150ms for 1-2 candidate reranks, <= 250ms when reranker runs on small GPU.
- Throughput target: sustained 150-250 QPS for peak support hours; burst 500 QPS for incident periods.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; procurement wants modeled cost per query across options (hosted Redwood + Pinecone vs Dedicated w/ pgvector). Need conservative TCO model.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must meet SOC2; ISO27001 preferred.
- Data residency requirement for EU customers (subset of corpus). Need per-index residency controls and audit logs.
- KMS integration required for encryption at rest; HSM optional.

POC scope (proposed):
- Week 0: Connector spec + infra diagram sign-off (Redwood + Cerulean infra).
- Weeks 1-3: Bulk backfill test of 10M docs to chosen vector backend; validate ingest rate and index size.
- Weeks 4-5: Implement retrieval+rerank pipeline; measure latency and topk recall.
- Weeks 6-8: Production-like load test (150-250 QPS sustained) and cost modeling; security review complete.

Stated internal champions: CTO (Nora Li) + Head of Search (Ravi Menon). Procurement contact: Alana Weiss.

Quoted customer sentiment snippets from calls: "If we can keep cost per query under $0.003 while hitting <150ms for most queries, this is an easy win." / "We cannot disrupt our Elastic-backed workflows — connector must be reversible."

Sales cues: strong engineering buyer, cares about measurable SLOs and cost modeling, receptive to hybrid deployment (Dedicated + Private for EU residency).

use_case_summary: Primary: enterprise RAG for customer support and internal knowledge with embeddings + reranking. Must integrate with large legacy Elastic index, support hybrid retrieval, and provide predictable per-query costs. POC to validate ingestion scale (10M -> 60M), latency SLOs, and connector behavior (bulk upsert, incremental sync, metadata filters).
indexing_scale_requirements: 60M documents -> ~350M chunks today; expect 3x growth in 12 months. Need connector that supports sharded bulk backfill, incremental CDC sync, and per-namespace lifecycle policies.
connector_requirements: Bulk upsert, streaming ingest, incremental sync/CDC, metadata filtering, namespace mapping, per-collection tenancy, backpressure signals, embedding versioning, ability to hybrid-query Elastic + ANN store, metrics (p95 latency, qps, vector store cost), secure credentials via KMS/HSM, support for pgvector export/import, optional Elastic connector for phased migration.
technical_blockers: VPC peering setup complexity + network egress rules, Elastic index mapping mismatches, unknown memory profile for reranker under load, per-query cost uncertainty for top-k reranking at scale.
